english.title: Keep a vehicle and trailer with no registration plate - registered before 1/10/38
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) kept a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), with a trailer attached, on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the registration mark assigned to the vehicle by the Secretary of State under section 23(1) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 was not fixed in the manner prescribed by Regulation 7 of the Road Vehicles (Display of Registration Marks) Regulations 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes:
(i) See Section 42(4) to (6) for defences
(ii) Regulation 7 does not apply to works trucks, road rollers and agricultural machines first registered before 1st October 1938.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
